journey.name: Navigation State Retention - Pane Boundary
journey.description:
Verifies that screen state survives the window crossing between the single-pane layout (folded, compact width) and the two-pane list-detail layout (unfolded, medium or expanded width). Scroll position and loaded content must be the same on both sides of the crossing, for the list pane and for a sub-route shown in the detail pane (nubecita-owmt.3). Infinite scroll must keep working after the crossing (nubecita-bm14).
Requires a foldable device or emulator. Start with the device unfolded.

actions.action: Verify that the device is unfolded and the app shows the Home feed with a navigation rail
Tap the Search tab on the main navigation
Type a search query into the search input field and submit the search
Verify that post search results are displayed in the list pane
Scroll the search results down slowly until the first result that was visible is off screen
Verify that search results are displayed, and record the text of the topmost fully visible result
Fold the device
Verify that the app shows a bottom navigation bar, that search results are displayed, and that the topmost fully visible result is the recorded one
Unfold the device
Verify that the app shows a navigation rail, that search results are displayed in the list pane, and that the topmost fully visible result is the recorded one
Tap the topmost fully visible search result to open it in the detail pane
Verify that the post detail is visible in the detail pane next to the search results
Scroll the post detail down slowly until the focused post is off screen, if the thread is long enough to scroll
Verify that the post detail is visible, and record the text of its topmost fully visible post
Fold the device
Verify that the post detail is shown full screen and that its topmost fully visible post is the recorded one
Unfold the device
Verify that the search results and the post detail are shown side by side and that each pane's topmost fully visible item is the recorded one
Tap the Home tab on the main navigation
Scroll the Home feed down slowly for several screens
Fold the device
Unfold the device
Scroll the Home feed down slowly for several more screens
Verify that the Home feed keeps loading older posts and does not stop at an end that never loads
